name: claude-utopia
description: Claude Code mods and plugins: a status band and workbench, a progress board, multi-model code review, and guardrails. Under active development.

plugins.name: dashboard
plugins.description: UI layer: a status band plus a seven-page workbench (Overview / Agents / Reviews / GPU / Timeline / Usage / Progress; Reviews, GPU and Progress show once they have data) via /dashboard, /subagents, /mmrun, /gpu, /timeline.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Skills and guard hooks: ai-code-cleanup, interrogate, shape-task, verify-change, setup, plus a git guard for the shared main worktree and a guard against reading API-key config files.

plugins.name: mm
plugins.description: Multi-model cross review and task dispatch: /mm:review and /mm:run, backed by mmrun.

plugins.name: progress
plugins.description: A per-project progress board: after each typed turn that edited files or made a commit, the plugin records its work through a Sonnet completion and mirrors it to an optional Artifact canvas.
